about: P62 T1 sealed scene set: 24 new English sentences written 27. 10. 2026 before the first P62 scene change, from nouns only (no competitor game, no run on these sentences). Families: interior = the game is played inside a building or a cave; outdoor = an open-air place; missing-foe = a named foe that main draws without its own model (the head noun is in evals/play/p62/missing-nouns.json; checked once against the library lookup, never by playing). Every sentence names a distinct place and a foe or an item. hero, foe, item and world are the sentence's own words, labelled when written. Opened once in T7 (holdout-opened.json); nothing is tuned on it.

sentences.text: A security guard chases rats through an empty shopping mall at night
Grab ten cereal boxes off the shelves of a supermarket before it closes
A kitten knocks the vases off every shelf in a cozy living room
A welder dodges runaway forklifts in a car factory
A jester battles armored guards in the great hall of a castle
A gem hunter gathers glowing crystals deep in a cave while bats swoop down
A busboy collects coffee mugs left all over a cozy cafe
A janitor dodges runaway wheelchairs in a hospital corridor
A farmer chases escaped pigs back into the barn on a muddy farm
A sandcastle builder fends off stinging jellyfish on a sunny beach
A yak carries supplies over a windy mountain pass while boulders tumble down
A park ranger puts out campfires left burning in a pine forest
A window cleaner collects lost kites from the rooftops of a rainy city
A moon rover scoops up moon rocks on a crater field while meteors rain down
A nomad collects water jugs while crossing the dunes of a desert
A sea witch hurls fireballs at pirate ships on a stormy ocean
A sea otter zaps electric eels that invade a rocky tide pool
A groundskeeper guards a soccer pitch from moles digging holes before the big match
A spelunker crawls through a flooded mine shaft while stalactites crash down
A lost tourist runs through a red canyon from angry walking cacti
A dog walker hurries through a stormy park dodging falling branches
A rusty tin can escapes the hydraulic presses of a scrapyard
A puppy fights living cardboard boxes in a post office sorting room
A shopkeeper dodges slamming metal shutters in a night market
